title: Chapter 450 Chaos Formation
content:
Chapter 450 Chaos Formation

"Seniors, judging from this posture, the other party seems to be trying to send their strong men in one by one. Who should we send to fight?"

A strong man from the Human Emperor Palace bravely stepped forward and asked.

Hao Yusheng looked at the powerful man from the Gods outside the light curtain and said indifferently: "Depending on this situation, the strong man sent to the opposite side shall not exceed the Supreme Immortal Class Heaven."

Wu Hui nodded, "So, only we can deal with it."

"I will kill the first one."

Zhan Kuangren suddenly stood up, licked his dry lips, and looked out of the light curtain with his eyes as if he was torched.

"I have lived for so long and have never killed any creatures in another world."

Seeing that the war madman was surging, the other immortal-grade supreme powerful people stopped talking.

Since you want to go, I will just keep my strength.

Shi Zhong remained silent, but after thinking about it, he still felt that he should ask Lu Xue. After all, Lu Xue is the most prestigious person on the scene, no doubt about it.

"Palace Lord Lu, what do you think?"

Everyone's eyes also looked at Lu Xue.

Lu Xue showed a sneer, "If they really dare to put people in one by one, then we will catch the turtle in the jar."

"Um?!"

Everyone was slightly stunned.

Wu Hui reacted and said, "What do you mean, group fight?"

Lu Xue nodded, "Of course, do you still want to fight etiquette against these beasts?"

Everyone laughed dryly, their faces a little awkward.

They actually thought about destroying each other's majesty on one-on-one.

The pattern is still small.

And at this moment, a figure entered the broken loophole.

He was wearing light yellow armor, holding a red spear in his hand, and a rebellious smile on his face.

"Is this the Chaos Realm? It's really low."

As he said that, the man with a gun looked at Lu Xue and others and smiled grimly, "Who will come to die first?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her expressionlessly, "Go!"

In an instant, several powerful figures rushed forward.

The man holding the gun suddenly stiffened his smile, then turned into a hint of horror, "Lying,,"

Rumble!

Puff ~

"No, stop beating, I surrender, I surrender!!"

"Hmph, since the beasts in the land of the gods have stepped into my Chaos Realm and are still thinking of surrendering, there is no door!"

"Kill him!!"

The screams were heard frequently, and Lu Xue was still expressionless.

It has to be said that this man holding a gun is still very good. He was able to breathe a few breaths in the hands of several top immortal-grade supreme men such as Wu Hui.

But the man with the gun obviously didn't want to die just like that.

"Wait, wait a moment, I'm not from the Land of Gods, I'm not!"

"stop!"

Hearing the man holding a gun begging for mercy, Lu Xue signaled everyone to stop.

"You are not from the land of the gods?"

Lu Xue asked the man with a gun.

Naturally, she would not trust the other person so easily, but at the first glance she saw the other person's difference with the rest of the gods' land.

This guy doesn't look that pure.

The man holding the gun was already dying at this time. Seeing that everyone finally stopped, he seemed to be a poor man in a wandering desert and suddenly drank sweet spring water and quickly gasped.

"I, I am not, I am, a creature in the golden world."

"Golden world? Hoho, it's interesting."

"Wu Hui, search for his soul." Lu Xue ordered.

"good."

Wu Hui did not hesitate and directly pressed his hand on the man's head.

Under the horrified gaze of the man holding the gun, his soul was immediately severely damaged.

"ah!!!"

A shrill scream echoed in the void.

Soon, Wu Hui's face became strange and he breathed another time. Wu Hui's eyes were filled with murderous intent when he looked at the man holding the gun.

"The Lord of the Palace, this person is indeed a creature in the Golden World, but he betrayed the Golden World and turned to the Land of Gods. In the end, the Golden World was also captured by the Land of Gods."

As soon as these words came out, everyone was suddenly furious.

What they hate the most is the traitor.

"Kill!"

Lu Xue's face was cold, like a thousand years of black ice.

Such people are not to be jealous of death.

Wu Hui had no mercy and directly wiped out the vitality of the man holding a gun, and even raised his soul.

In this way, the first enemy was easily solved by them.

And at this time, outside the Chaos Realm.

"Sir God-Eye, he is dead."

A creature from the land of the gods reported.

Upon hearing this news, the three-eyed creature was not surprised at all, as if he had known the ending for a long time.

"Have you just persisted for such a little time? It seems that the natives in this world still have some skills."

Then, the three-eyed creature looked at the position behind his body and asked softly, "How is it, what's wrong?"

I saw a creature with a radish-like head was brewing a black pot, his eyes closed, and he muttered something in his mouth.

After a moment, he suddenly said, "My God Eye, give me a little more time, and I will definitely be able to break this light curtain."

"With the inferiority of this world, I hope they can't create such a powerful light curtain, and they will definitely be able to find a way to crack it, even,

The carrot man paused and continued with a grin, "You can also find the source of the light curtain to crack the light curtain, and then severely damage the other party. You have good luck, hehehe, it is not a problem to kill directly."

Hearing these words, the three-eyed creature looked overjoyed and laughed, "Okay, if this light curtain is broken, I will definitely recommend you to the priest."

"Thank you, Lord God Eye!"

The three-eyed creature was in a good mood and looked at the light curtain of the Chaos Realm here, "Continue to release people, weaken the other party's guards, and open a few more holes for me!"

Under the control of the three-eyed creature, several loopholes appeared on the light curtain one after another, and it was increasing.

Fortunately, the more loopholes, the harder it is to dig.

But even so, it made everyone in the Chaos Realm feel heavy.

"Senior Lu Xue, it seems that the other party has seen through the measures I have been waiting for."

Wu Hui sighed softly.

Lu Xue's eyes were deep, and at this moment, a voice came from behind her.

"My master, I'm here!"

Hearing this extremely familiar voice, Lu Xue suddenly turned around and looked.

I saw Ao Qing leading the powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan towards here in a mighty manner.

"This guy."

Although Lu Xue was still a little angry at Ao Qing's style not long ago, Lu Xue chose to forgive her for the timely support she saw Ao Qing's timely support.

They are really short of staff now.

However, this is not over yet. Below, there are continuous figures coming towards this side.

Those are the strong men from all over the Chaos Realm, most of them are on the combat power list, but even so, if all the lands of the gods are put into battle, then they have no advantage.

Just as Lu Xue was extremely worried, an old but excited laugh came.

Immediately afterwards, an unprecedented large array covered the entire Chaos Realm, and rose up with the deserted city as the center.

"Hahahaha, the Chaos Array, It's Complete!"
